high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of a social media post from an Instagram account named "wikkiofficial." The post was made 6 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 1:01 AM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner of the screen. The main content of the post is an advertisement for the Tokyo Filmex International Film Festival, which took place from October 30 to November 7, 2021. The festival is associated with the film "Pebbles" (also known as "Koozhangal"), which is presented by Nayanthara & V
